name: sportsdataio_injuries
description: Current injuries in the NFL / NBA / MLB / NHL / CFB / CBB — returns each injured player with team, position, status (Out, Questionable, etc.) and the body part affected. Note: a free SportsDataIO trial key returns scrambled sample data, not real injuries. Example: sportsdataio_injuries({ league: "nfl", _apiKey: "your-key" })

league.description: League to query. One of: nfl / nba / mlb / nhl / cfb / cbb.

_apiKey.description: SportsDataIO API key (free trial at sportsdata.io/developers)

name: sportsdataio_projections
description: Projected player stats for a slate — fantasy points plus key projected stats per player. Daily sports (NBA / MLB / NHL / CBB) take a `date`; weekly sports (NFL / CFB) take `season` + `week`. Note: a free trial key returns scrambled sample data. Example: sportsdataio_projections({ league: "nba", date: "2026-01-15", _apiKey: "your-key" }) or sportsdataio_projections({ league: "nfl", season: "2025REG", week: 5, _apiKey: "your-key" })

league.description: League to query. One of: nfl / nba / mlb / nhl / cfb / cbb.

date.description: Game date in YYYY-MM-DD format (used for NBA/MLB/NHL/CBB), e.g. "2026-01-15"

season.description: Season for weekly sports (NFL/CFB), e.g. "2025REG", "2025POST", or "2025"

week.description: Week number for weekly sports (NFL/CFB), e.g. 5

name: sportsdataio_player_props
description: Player prop bets for a date — available betting markets and outcomes (over/under totals, payouts) across NFL / NBA / MLB / NHL / CFB / CBB. Requires a SEPARATE SportsDataIO Odds/Props API key (the Props warehouse is billed apart from Stats/Projections). Note: a free trial key returns scrambled sample data. Example: sportsdataio_player_props({ league: "nba", date: "2026-01-15", _apiKey: "your-odds-key" })

league.description: League to query. One of: nfl / nba / mlb / nhl / cfb / cbb.

date.description: Slate date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-01-15"

_apiKey.description: SportsDataIO Odds/Props API key (separate from the Stats key)
